name: Carousel
description: A framework-free Web Component built on a scroll-snapping track: native swiping, pointer dragging, four transitions, and a strip of pictures that still scrolls with no script at all.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: The scrolling track with arrows, position dots, swiping and dragging.

variants.name: Transitions
variants.description: The four ways one picture gives way to the next, side by side.

variants.name: Drag
variants.description: Dragging with the pointer: how far commits, how fast commits, and what happens at the ends.

variants.name: Peek
variants.description: More than one picture in the frame, with the next one showing at the edge.

variants.name: Autoplay
variants.description: Advancing on its own, with a pause control and every reason it stops.

variants.name: States
variants.description: One picture with no controls at all, ends that are real ends, and captions.
